summary: Verified iteration 273 changes: admin auth on all /api/admin/* data endpoints, AUD $24.99 / $189.99 / $369 pricing, Google Play Billing scaffolding (config + verify), web checkout still creates Stripe sessions, web /pricing UI unaffected by Play Billing, settings membership renders for non-subscribed QA user. 14/14 backend tests passed; frontend flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: playbilling.py _access_token() imports/creds are validated but every request re-loads credentials from env (fine for now, but consider caching once GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is populated).

admin.py: /api/admin/files/{path} is public and returns raw bytes from Emergent object storage. Confirmed intentional per spec (image serving). No auth bypass concerns for other admin routes — every mutation and listing route uses Depends(_verify_admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified endpoints: GET /api/admin/collections (401 unauth, 403 non-admin), POST /api/admin/{c}/items (403 non-admin), POST /api/admin/login (401 wrong pw), GET /api/admin/files/{path} (public), GET /api/payments/plans (currency=AUD, monthly 24.99, yearly 189.99, full_app_unlock 369), POST /api/payments/create-checkout monthly & yearly with product_type=subscription + origin_url required, GET /api/playbilling/config (public, verification_configured=false, lifetime_available=false), POST /api/playbilling/verify (401 unauth, 503 configured+known product, 400 unknown product). Frontend /pricing correctly falls back to Stripe/PayPal in non-TWA browsers (play-billing-section hidden). /admin route guard redirects non-admin users to /dashboard. settings-no-subscription rendered for QA user.
